issues.description: The UML in the problem statement declares the Lecture attributes as private (minus sign), and the solution implements them as private fields with getters/setters. However, the template declares the existing attributes (lectureName and numberOfInscribedStudents) as public. This visibility mismatch can confuse students about whether fields should be public or private and whether getters/setters are required.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the visibility of the attributes in the template Lecture.java to private to match the UML and the solution (and to reinforce the use of getters/setters). For example, declare private String lectureName; private int numberOfInscribedStudents; and add the other missing private attributes. Keep the getters/setters tasks unchanged.
